accepted_scope: The 23 recorded events (22 eligible complete events across 22 issuers, plus CXT, included but not eligible) drawn from the frozen cohort of 243 candidates across 215 issuers, under the amended pilot protocol: daily regular-session, previous-close-anchored reaction labels (day-1 open/high/low/close, gap thresholds, gap fill and retention, closes at sessions 2, 5, 10 and 20) for premarket and after-hours earnings releases from 2026-01-05 to 2026-03-31, computed from Alpaca SIP raw daily bars with explicit corporate-action handling and published only as derived values.
accepted_with_these_stated_limits: The chronology gap that search cannot close: the absence of an earlier public disclosure is evidenced by wire pages and SEC filing history, never proved.
One named reviewer, the project owner, under the 2026-09-22 amendment; there was no independent second review.

Label-level caveats travel with their events: ACHV, COLL, OKTA and REAL have in-window 8-Ks affecting later horizons; LNSR follows a merger termination two weeks earlier; CXT is included but not eligible because a dividend suppresses its session-20 label.
The provider-rights authorization covers derived ratios, booleans, counts and hashes only, confirmed explicitly for about twenty-three recorded events; no raw prices are committed or printed.
The amended target (20 events, 15 issuers) and the amended accounting rule are the owner's decisions; 205 candidates were never reviewed and no claim is made about them.
The frozen sample is the 300 issuers processed under the pinned rule, not the market.
The engine's own stated limit stands: "Hashes and declarations establish internal consistency, not genuine publication, permission or review. Independent evidence sign-off is still required."
not_authorized_or_claimed: Milestone 2, or any later milestone, is not authorized; it requires the project owner's separate explicit approval.
No predictive claim, validated edge or trading use: the target was an engineering coverage goal, not evidence of predictive power.
The frozen BOE, SOE and IEE rules are untouched.
The engine flag is not set: nre.acceptance.audit_cohort reports milestone_accepted false by design, because acceptance is a human declaration outside the code. This file is that declaration.
note_for_milestone_2_planning: Each of the 22 issuers with an eligible event contributes exactly one event, so the accepted dataset supports no company-level histories or event-type distributions. That is a property of the accepted dataset, not a limitation of the acceptance.
housekeeping: The SEC freeze artifact used by the source-hash gate expires on 2026-10-20; the final audit record preserves this result, and the owner holds NRE-M1-SEC-Freeze-Audit.zip.
